correctness.evidence: Independent exact integer recount reproduced all committed Ehrhart counts through k=9, all three h*-vectors, and the three explicit indecomposable 2P witnesses.

originality.evidence: Braun–Davis–Solus arXiv:1608.01614 covers the two-part family; t=1 is a control, while t=3,9 are genuinely three-part. Novelty is limited to the exact finite census/certificate layer, not a new general Hibi–Oda theorem.

scientific_value.evidence: The exact polynomials, h*-vectors and non-IDP witnesses form reusable low-dimensional benchmark data for reflexive-simplex and IDP/unimodality computations.

decision: Validated on all three axes, with originality and value explicitly limited to the finite exact data/certificate layer.
